sentence_text: Energy Governance for a Just Energy Transition
Scroll, tab or use your keyboard to move ahead

This module explores energy governance as a key enabler of a <ai prompt="Clarify just energy transition.">just energy transition 💬️</ai>, introducing the Energy Governance focus areas—inclusive and effective institutions, civic engagement, legal and regulatory frameworks, and independent oversight—alongside four cross-cutting approaches: people-centered inclusivity, multi-level governance, digital enablement, and adaptability.
It provides insights into policy coherence, stakeholder engagement, and transparency, with case studies illustrating governance challenges and solutions.

The module equips decision-makers with tools to strengthen accountability, inclusivity, and institutional effectiveness, ensuring energy transitions are equitable, sustainable, and responsive to evolving global needs.
Understand what energy governance is and how it can act as an enabler in achieving energy access and accelerating a just energy transition
Identify and describe the four focus areas of Energy Governance along with some examples and recommendations
Learn about four critical cross-cutting approaches crucial for these focus areas
Learn about the stakeholder engagement, political economy understanding, policy coherence, adaptive regulations, de-risking and other critical aspects of governance
